items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: I played for David Allen, who was one heck of a singer.

ctx.x: But that was my first record contact. The first record company I was ever with was Discovery with Albert Marks. I played for David Allen, who was one heck of a singer. You didn’t hear too much about him, another case of being too good. That’s the case today I think. Because none of the real fine singers have record contracts. Jack Jones I think doesn’t have a contract, Steve and Eydie don’t have a contract. And I mean they’re all, from my standpoint, they’re the best singers around.
Tell me about working with Ella if you don’t mind.
